summary: ASTRA-MON is a health-monitoring dashboard prototype designed to support astronaut health awareness during long-duration space missions. It displays simulated crew health indicators, including heart rate, blood oxygen saturation (SpO₂), body temperature, blood pressure and stress levels. The system highlights unusual readings through status indicators and alerts, helping users identify potential concerns and review health trends over time. Its design is informed by NASA Human Research Program resources on cardiovascular changes, hypoxia and other human spaceflight health risks. ASTRA-MON aims to demonstrate how a clear, centralized monitoring interface could support crew awareness and mission-health communication. The current prototype uses simulated telemetry and is not a medical diagnostic or flight-certified system.
details:
ASTRA-MON is a mission-control-inspired health monitoring dashboard prototype. It provides a centralized view of crew health indicators and highlights readings that cross illustrative alert thresholds.Key Features

  • Crew member selection and individual health summaries.
  • Heart rate, SpO₂, body temperature and blood pressure monitoring.
  • Stress indicator and health status overview.
  • Warning and critical alert display.
  • Health history and trend visualization.
  • Simulated telemetry updates for demonstration.

How It Works

The prototype displays simulated astronaut telemetry through a web dashboard. The application evaluates incoming demonstration values against configurable illustrative thresholds and displays corresponding status indicators and alerts. Users can select crew members and review their health information.

Technology

The planned implementation uses HTML, CSS and JavaScript for the interface, Node.js and Express for the server, and chart visualization for health trends.

NASA Resources

The design is informed by NASA Human Research Program resources describing human spaceflight health risks, including cardiovascular adaptations and hypoxia.

Impact and Future Scope

ASTRA-MON demonstrates a possible approach to presenting astronaut health information in one accessible interface. Future development could include validated sensor integration, anomaly detection, secure medical data handling and offline mission support.

Limitations

All current demonstration readings are simulated. The prototype is not clinically validated, does not diagnose medical conditions and is not approved for operational astronaut health decisions.
